name: rmbaid-advanced-elicitation
description: Push the LLM to reconsider, refine, and improve its recent output. Use when user asks for deeper critique or mentions a known deeper critique method, e.g. socratic, first principles, pre-mortem, red team.

name: rmbaid-brainstorming
description: Facilitate interactive brainstorming sessions using diverse creative techniques and ideation methods. Use when the user says help me brainstorm or help me ideate.

name: rmbaid-command-hub
description: Renamed BMAD-style command shell and router. Use when you want slash commands shortcut aliases renamed personas and one-mode-at-a-time routing across SMART.

name: rmbaid-distillator
description: Lossless LLM-optimized compression of source documents. Use when the user requests to 'distill documents' or 'create a distillate'.

name: rmbaid-editorial-review-prose
description: Clinical copy-editor that reviews text for communication issues. Use when user says review for prose or improve the prose

name: rmbaid-editorial-review-structure
description: Structural editor that proposes cuts, reorganization, and simplification while preserving comprehension. Use when user requests structural review or editorial review of structure

name: rmbaid-elevate
description: Renamed compatibility mode for BMAD-style promote. Use when you want to improve the latest answer draft plan or artifact through structured critique and refinement.

name: rmbaid-expert-view
description: Specialist panel analysis mode. Use when you need expert viewpoints consensus recommendations or cross-functional tradeoff analysis on a decision artifact or plan.

name: rmbaid-help
description: Analyzes current state and user query to answer RMB_AID questions or recommend the next skill(s) to use. Use when user asks for help, rmbaid help, what to do next, or what to start with in RMB_AID.

name: rmbaid-ideate
description: Renamed ideation mode for brainstorming and option expansion. Use when you want a BMAD-style lightweight command for idea generation before planning or implementation.

name: rmbaid-index-docs
description: Generates or updates an index.md to reference all docs in the folder. Use if user requests to create or update an index of all files in a specific folder

name: rmbaid-party-mode
description: Orchestrates group discussions between installed RMB_AID agents, enabling natural multi-agent conversations where each agent is a real subagent with independent thinking. Use when user requests party mode, wants multiple agent perspectives, group discussion, roundtable, or multi-agent conversation about their project.

name: rmbaid-review-adversarial-general
description: Perform a Cynical Review and produce a findings report. Use when the user requests a critical review of something

name: rmbaid-review-edge-case-hunter
description: Walk every branching path and boundary condition in content, report only unhandled edge cases. Orthogonal to adversarial review - method-driven not attitude-driven. Use when you need exhaustive edge-case analysis of code, specs, or diffs.

name: rmbaid-shard-doc
description: Splits large markdown documents into smaller, organized files based on level 2 (default) sections. Use if the user says perform shard document

name: rmbaid-squad
description: Renamed collaboration mode for multi-agent discussion and role debate. Use when you want BMAD-style party mode with a simpler command surface.

name: rmbaid-verify
description: Renamed compatibility mode for validation and review. Use when you want to check correctness completeness readiness or risks across code docs plans or generated artifacts.
